label: Emerging
description: These sites are in the early stages of readiness. Some foundational due diligence may be complete, but additional documentation and development steps are needed.

label: Bronze
description: Sites at this level meet basic readiness standards. Core infrastructure and documentation are in place, but there may still be a few key areas requiring additional work or clarification.

label: Silver
description: Sites at this level demonstrate a strong overall readiness profile, with many key elements of due diligence in place. There may still be a few areas where additional work could improve the site's competitiveness.

label: Gold
description: Gold sites reflect a high level of preparedness, with nearly all due diligence completed and minimal (if any) barriers to immediate development.

label: Platinum
description: These are exceptional sites with comprehensive due diligence, excellent infrastructure access, and a high degree of development readiness. Platinum designations are rare and reflect the highest tier of readiness in the program.
